data.subject: [HR-1006] Third time asking, where is my order?
data.description:
Market: UK
Language: en
Order: HR-UK-55340
Received: 2026-09-16T15:48:00Z
Source channel: chat

This is my THIRD message about order HR-UK-55340. It was meant to arrive on 3 September. Each time I have been told it is "with the carrier" and will arrive "in 2 to 3 working days". It is now 16 September.

I bought this as a wedding gift and the wedding is on Saturday. If it does not arrive by Friday I want a full refund and I want someone to actually tell me what is going on. Please do not send me another template.

Helen Marsh
